prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Account Creation Sequence Reorder: Reorder the onboarding flow so account sign-in occurs after pet adoption and certificate creation.
   config: {"sign_in": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Grid Companion Selection Redesign: Transform the pet choice view into a grid layout with visual preview cards and animated mascots.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "label": "Select Pet Character"}]}}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Adoption Companion Preference Screen: Add a dedicated preference screening step prior to selecting a companion.
   config: {"new_companion_quiz": {"headline": "Find Your Ideal Companion", "body": "Select the personality and activity level that matches your daily desktop routine.", "layout": "card", "button_label": "Show Matching Pets"}, "pick_friend": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_companion_quiz", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}}
3: [finish, redesign] Interactive Home Welcome Redesign: Redesign the home introduction screen into a stage layout featuring an interactive pet mascot and control guide.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"role": "home_welcome", "type": "mascot", "style": "highlight", "asset": "asset:pet_welcome"}, {"role": "home_welcome", "type": "text", "style": "plain", "text": "Right-click your pet anytime to summon desktop controls, hide, or interact."}]}}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Selection Redesign: Redesign path selection into a full story scroll layout with interactive animated path previews.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded", "label": "Choose Your Pet Path"}]}}}
5: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Adoption Certificate View: Rebuild the adoption certificate summary into a stage layout with centered pet animations.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "replace": {"certificate": [{"role": "certificate", "type": "preview", "style": "large", "asset": "asset:pet_preview"}]}}}
6: [sign_in, copy] Multi-Device Pet Sync Account Copy: Update sign-in headline and body to highlight safe cloud synchronization and pet retrieval across devices.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe Across Devices", "body": "Your pet customization and progress are saved to your cloud account so you never lose your companion."}}
7: [sign_in, copy] Account Data Retention Sign-In Copy: Clarify sign-in subtext to state that re-authenticating restores existing pets rather than starting fresh.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Restore & Secure Your Pet Account", "body": "Logging in connects your active desktop pet to your permanent account. Re-sign in anytime to restore lost pets."}}
8: [adoption, layout] Two Column Photo Upload Layout: Reframe the custom photo upload step into a two-column layout with photo quality previews and tips.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "two_column", "replace": {"photo_upload": [{"role": "photo_upload", "type": "photo_picker", "style": "rounded", "label": "Upload Pet Photo"}]}}}
9: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Guidance Copy: Revise the final completion screen headline and body to explain basic mouse shortcuts and hiding controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "body": "Click and drag to move your companion. Right-click to open actions, switch modes, or hide your pet anytime."}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in within the onboarding flow is explicitly permitted.
Grid layout redesign retains the job of letting the user choose a pet.
Adding a preference quiz screen within onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the home intro screen preserves its essential functions.
Story scroll redesign maintains the path selection options.
Replacing the certificate content with only a pet preview removes the required official stamp.
Copy update for sign-in is accurate and contains no prohibited references.
Sign-in copy revision clearly explains data retention without dark patterns.
Two-column redesign of photo upload retains the photo selection functionality.
Home intro copy update provides desktop control guidance without violating rules.
